   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  May 11, 2026

Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:02 p.m. and Vice Chair Lopez led the Flag Salute.
Responding to roll call were Chair Ang, Vice Chair Lopez, Commissioner Garcia, and Commissioner
Sanchez. Also present was Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, and Laura Zaldivar, Community
Information Assistant.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Vice Chair Sanchez made the motion and Commissioner Garcia seconded to approve the minutes for
April 13, 2026. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Native Garden Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda informed the Commission that only one entry has been received for the contest so far
and is still working with Cerritos College to get gift certificates to their Native Sanctuary for the winners.

Commissioners Appreciation Dinner

Ms. Ocegueda presented the picnic-themed flyer invitation and three food options for their review and
approval. Commissioners approved flyer invitation and chose the Norwalk High School Culinary
Program to cater the event. Commissioners decided on gift certificates from Keepin’ It Norwalk business
winners to raffle off as prizes during the event.

Keepin’ It Norwalk

Miss Zaldivar presented the “Keepin’ It Norwalk” campaign video, April Meat Market/Carniceria edition,
to the Commissioners.

Communications Analytics

Miss Zaldivar presented monthly performance metrics across digital platforms. The Commission
received and filed the report.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda showed Commissioners the vinyl decal sticker that will be distributed to all 2026 winners
of the Keepin’ It Norwalk campaign.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Lopez attended a neighboring city's 5K event and, based on that experience, expressed
pride in the organization and execution of the City of Norwalk's 5K. Commissioner Sanchez shared
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting

similar sentiments regarding Norwalk's event and confirmed that he will be attending the City's Memorial
Day Ceremony. Commissioner Sanchez also informed Commissioners that the Sanchez Halloween
Parade Foundation is hosting a turn-around trip to Vieja’s Casino on July 26, 2026, if anyone is
interested in joining them.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 6:55 p.m.

_____________________________

David Ang, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
